title: The Apostles Imprisoned and Freed by an Angel
description: The high priest and the Sadducees imprison the apostles out of jealousy, but during the night an angel of the Lord opens the prison doors and frees them. They return to the temple to teach, are brought before the Council again, and Peter declares that one must obey God rather than men. Following Gamaliel's advice to leave them alone, the apostles are flogged and released, and they continue joyfully preaching about Jesus Christ.
